channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Study: 93% of Indigenous Australians lost in 73 years
item.description: A study suggests 2.22 million Indigenous Australians lived on the continent before European colonization, far more than previously estimated.

item.title: Why some workout recovery tricks backfire
item.description: Ice baths, massages, compression garments, and recovery supplements promise faster muscle recovery, but research suggests benefits are often overstated.

item.title: Childhood exercise may ease adult workouts
item.description: Physical activity during childhood could provide a lasting benefit, making exercise less tiring in adulthood, according to a study.

item.title: Forgotten fossil reveals dinosaur with giant claws
item.description: A 120-million-year-old fossil left in a museum for nearly a century has revealed a new dinosaur that may have been more dangerous to humans.
